prompt: Black learns to share the red truck
title: The Red Truck
irony: Black keeps the red truck all to himself, but the truck only zooms when friends push it with him.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Moon lights the quiet street where a shiny red truck waits under the lamp.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Black hugs the red truck and shouts every turn stays with him.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Navy and Jade ask for a turn, Lilac calls the share-before-lamp-out rule, Black holds on tight.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street gathers round the red truck and sings the sharing chant together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black tries to zoom the red truck alone and wedges its wheel hard against the curb.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Navy and Jade pull one way, Black pulls the other, and the truck spins them into a laughing heap.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends pick up the red truck, dust it off, and sing the sharing chant again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold sits with the kids under the lamp and hums how keeping everything leaves hands empty.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold offers timed turns pushing together, and Black nods and takes the back rope.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: All push the red truck together down the street, laughing as it finally zooms.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Under the lamp the red truck rests as friends trade turns and wave goodnight.
